title: 第14章 一千份药材第15章 少主选拨赛
content_zh:
一个时辰后。
议事厅。
长老齐集。
陆家九位长老，有七位神色轻松，连大长老都露出了罕见的笑容。
二长老陆正宁见气氛古怪，正在纳闷。
旁边的四长老却是苦大仇深似的，控诉陆沉的罪恶，揭露陆沉偷了丹馆许多丹药，要求严惩陆沉！
“陆沉偷丹馆的中品炼体丹”
众长老先是一愣，随后便是一阵哄笑。
“怎么，诸位长老不信我”
四长老气愤的道。
“四长老，你这两天呆在内务房，外面有些事你还不知晓。”
陆正宁脸色古怪的看了四长老一眼，没好气的说道，“陆沉，在丹馆跟周鸿斗丹，赢了一百枚中品炼体丹。”
“啊！”
四长老一征，感到老脸一阵滚烫，仿佛被人刮了一巴掌。
随后，四长老又不甘心的说道，“那他也不应该拿着这些丹药，跑到内务房搞事，引诱族人不领月俸。”
“陆沉影响内务房的正常工作，的确过份，理应惩罚！”
陆正宁想都不想，直接给四长老撑腰。
“陆沉把赢来的丹药，全分给了自家人，又没给外人，怎么过份了呢”
大长老率先开口，缓缓说道，“这种举动对陆家有益，理应表扬才是。”
“大长老所言极是，正所谓肥水不流外人田，一百枚中品炼体丹全部落在咱们的子弟手中，不知有多少子弟因此提升修为，受益的始终是咱们陆家啊。”

“陆沉现在也是炼体境，中品炼体丹对他也有莫大的好处，他自己却不用，全部分给族人，为家族的兴旺作出贡献，这叫舍已为人，有大牺牲精神啊！”
“中品炼体丹的药力，是下品炼体丹的好多倍，价钱也贵好多倍，寻常子弟哪里吃得起换作是我，宁愿不要几个月的月俸，也要一枚中品炼体丹啊。”
“陆沉分丹药，有让内务房受损失了吗许多人不领月俸，内务房还节省了一大笔呢，你不表扬陆沉也就算了，还要处罚他，真不知你安的是什么心”
其他长老也纷纷表态，不是赞成大长老，就是赞扬陆沉。
反正，无一支持四长老的提议。
“四长老，家族有传言，你在卡陆沉的月俸，是不是真的”
忽然，大长老冷不防的问了一句，语气有点不善。
“没，没有这回事，肯定是谣言。”
四长老连忙否认，内心有些虚了，也搞不懂状况了。
今天是啥日子啊
这么多长老突然给陆沉站边，究竟发生了什么事
平日，这班家伙对陆沉可没这么大的积极性。
content_en:
An hour later.
Chamber.
The elders gathered together.
Seven of the nine elders of the Lu family looked relaxed, and even the eldest elder showed a rare smile.
The second elder, Lu Zhengning, was wondering when he saw the strange atmosphere.
The fourth elder next to him was full of bitterness and hatred, accusing Lu Chen of his crimes, revealing that Lu Chen had stolen many pills from the alchemy hall, and demanding that Lu Chen be severely punished!
"Lu Chen stole the middle-grade body refining pill from the alchemy hall"
The elders were stunned for a moment, then burst into laughter.
"Why, the elders don't believe me?"
The fourth elder said angrily.
"Fourth Elder, you have been staying in the internal affairs room for the past two days. There are things outside that you don't know yet."
Lu Zhengning glanced at the fourth elder with a strange expression and said angrily, "Lu Chen, I fought with Zhou Hong in the alchemy hall and won a hundred middle-grade body refining pills."
"Ah!"
The fourth elder felt his face burning hot, as if he had been slapped.
Then, the fourth elder said unwillingly, "Then he shouldn't take these pills and go to the inner affairs room to cause trouble and lure the clan members not to receive their monthly salary."
"Lu Chen's influence on the normal work of the internal affairs room is indeed excessive and should be punished!"
Lu Zhengning directly supported the fourth elder without even thinking about it.
"Lu Chen gave all the pills he won to his own family and didn't give them to outsiders. Why is it too much?"
The elder spoke first and said slowly, "This kind of behavior is beneficial to the Lu family and should be praised."
"What the Great Elder said is absolutely true. As the saying goes, good things don't go to outsiders. One hundred middle-grade body refining pills all fell into the hands of our disciples. I don't know how many disciples have improved their cultivation as a result. It is our Lu family who will benefit."
"Lu Chen is also in the body-refining realm now. The middle-grade body-refining pills are of great benefit to him, but he doesn't use them himself. He gives them all to his clan and contributes to the prosperity of the clan. This is called sacrificing oneself for others and having a spirit of great sacrifice!"
"The potency of the middle-grade body refining pill is many times that of the low-grade body refining pill, and the price is also many times more expensive. How can ordinary people afford it? If it were me, I would rather not have a few months' monthly salary to get a middle-grade body refining pill."
"Did Lu Chen's distribution of pills cause losses to the internal affairs office? Many people did not receive their monthly salary, and the internal affairs office also saved a lot of money. It's okay if you don't praise Lu Chen, but you also punish him. I really don't know what your intentions are."
Other elders also expressed their opinions, either in favor of the elder or in praising Lu Chen.
Anyway, no one supported the Fourth Elder’s proposal.
"Fourth Elder, there are rumors in the family. Is your salary at Kaluchen true?"
Suddenly, the great elder asked coldly, with a somewhat unkind tone.
"No, there is no such thing. It must be a rumor."
The fourth elder quickly denied it, feeling a little weak and unable to understand the situation.
What day is today?
So many elders suddenly sided with Lu Chen. What happened?
Usually, these guys are not so enthusiastic about Lu Chen.
